responsibility: Defines the core target description macros for GCC’s MMIX port. This header fixes the ABI-visible register numbering, calling convention, stack and frame layout, endian and alignment properties, built-in preprocessor symbols, assembler and linker command specifications, register names, EH register assignments, and the many target macros that connect generic GCC storage layout, asm output, debugging, and code-generation infrastructure to MMIX-specific behavior implemented in mmix.cc and mmix.md.
same_name_distinction: Target-definition header for the MMIX port: it declares register numbers, ABI/layout constants, and GCC target macros and interfaces used by both mmix.cc and mmix.md, instead of implementing hook logic, encoding RTL instruction patterns, or defining -m options as the other same-stem files do.
